rationale: X01 flagged PRIVATE_EQUITY rows with nonblank interest_rate values. Raw SOI rows show the relevant rates are printed coupon or PIK terms on preferred equity, convertible preferred stock, preferred units, or partnership-interest instruments, so both the equity classification and the rate-bearing term are source-backed. The check is overbroad for rate-bearing preferred equity rather than exposing a data error.
